explanation: The Hessian of the deficit is bounded below by $((2K-1)\,\mathrm{lowerColumn}-4200K\,\mathrm{upperPair})|U|^2+(\mathrm{lowerTotal}-9K\,\mathrm{upperPair})|D|^2$ on the box, where the coefficients are $\ell_p$-norm Hessian bounds with corner constants of the box (`normHessian_lower_generic`, pair-coordinate geometry with constants $9$ and $4200$). Both margins hold uniformly on $p\in[32,50]$, $K\le p/2$ via $r^{p-2}\le (3/4)^{30}$ (`total_comparison`, `column_comparison`), giving `ConvexOn` on the box.
